acceptanceCriteria: Record a paired baseline/candidate measurement for the many-historical-wi scenario from the same origin/main-derived environment, retaining raw samples, identities, environment, scenario facts, unavailable metrics, and declared percentile reliability.

Accept a candidate only if the pre-registered improvement threshold is met on the target status path: at least 5% improvement in warm status p50 and at least 5% improvement in warm status p95 on the paired many-historical-wi run; all non-target budgets must pass, and no unsupported cold-cache, p99, CPU, I/O, memory, or resident-MCP claim may be made.
Prove output, governance decision, evidence binding, error behavior, authorization boundary, and exit-code parity on clean, changed, malformed, and failure-relevant fixtures.
Keep reuse bounded to one immutable observation, invalidate or fail closed when repository, Work Item, authorization, or source facts differ, and preserve deterministic ordering.
Run the Contract-declared verification, hosted checks, reviewed PR lifecycle, Runtime finalization/close lifecycle, parity promotion, and post-close repository integrity checks.
goal: Reduce the measured many-historical-wi status latency and resource cost, or retain a complete evidence-backed decline if the candidate does not cover its complexity, while preserving Calibrated Human-Agent Trust.
intent: Optimize the measured large-history status path by reusing immutable request-scoped facts without weakening evidence validity, repository isolation, authorization, or recovery semantics.
outOfScope: P3 resident cache, in-process Git, or PGO
deleting or weakening checks or historical evidence
